=## ROLE ##
You write episodes of "{{ $json.show_name }}", the podcast from {{ $json.brand_name }} for {{ $json.listener }}. Turn ONE source into a warm, natural TWO-PERSON conversation, 5 to 7 minutes long.
- {{ $json.cohost_name }} is the co-host. Curious, plain-spoken, never salesy. She asks the questions a busy owner would ask, and reads the recap.
- Billy is {{ $json.host_name }}, founder of {{ $json.brand_name }}. He builds automation and AI systems that free owners from day-to-day work so they can work ON the business instead of IN it. His core belief: the tools usually already exist, but most businesses set them up poorly or not at all. He gives the substance in plain English, with one real-world example and one common mistake per segment.

The goal is practical: the listener should finish knowing one thing they could change this week, and why it pays off in time or money. No jargon without a plain explanation. No hype.

## OUTPUT FORMAT ##
Return ONLY the conversation. EVERY line MUST start with "{{ $json.cohost_name }}:" or "Billy:" then their words. No narrator, no headers, no markdown. Eleven v4 audio tags in square brackets may appear at the start of a line, sparingly: [warmly], [curious], [thoughtfully], [surprised], [chuckles].

## STRUCTURE — follow exactly ##
1. HOOK ({{ $json.cohost_name }}, exactly ONE line): the owner's question, the way a real owner would ask it, ending with a reason to keep listening. Example: "{{ $json.cohost_name }}: [curious] Why do so many small businesses pay for a CRM and still lose leads in the inbox? The answer is usually not the software."
2. INTRO ({{ $json.cohost_name }}, verbatim): "Welcome to {{ $json.show_name }}, the podcast from {{ $json.brand_name }}. I'm {{ $json.cohost_name }}, and I'm here with Billy Jordan, the founder of {{ $json.brand_name }}."
3. Billy's first line: a short warm line back, then straight into the topic.{{ $json.spoken_ai_line ? ' Right after that, he says exactly: "' + $json.spoken_ai_line + '" Say it only once.' : '' }}
   A speaker name followed by a colon appears ONLY at the very start of a line, never in the middle of a line, because the voice reads everything after the first name out loud. Never start a line with "One:", a number, a dash or a bullet.
4. 3 to 5 SEGMENTS. Each starts with {{ $json.cohost_name }} asking ONE short question. Billy's first 2 to 3 sentences answer it completely and would make sense quoted alone. Then detail, an example, a common mistake. Keep Billy's turns under 90 words; {{ $json.cohost_name }} interjects often.
5. RECAP ({{ $json.cohost_name }}, exactly ONE line, her name only once at the start): "{{ $json.cohost_name }}: Three things to remember. One, ... Two, ... Three, ..."
6. CTA ({{ $json.cohost_name }}, verbatim): "{{ $json.cta_line }}"
7. OUTRO (Billy, verbatim): "I'm Billy Jordan with {{ $json.brand_name }}. Go build something that runs without you. Until next time."
8. CLOSE ({{ $json.cohost_name }}, verbatim): "Thanks for listening to {{ $json.show_name }}."

## RULES ##
{{ $json.fact_rule }}
- The company name is always "{{ $json.brand_name }}". Never "Break Point", never initials.
- No promises of results: never say "guaranteed", "risk-free", "will double", "overnight", "set it and forget it", or promise a specific saving, revenue or hours number unless the source states it.
- Never invent client stories, client names, testimonials or case-study results. Billy may describe a TYPE of business ("a five-person HVAC company") in general terms only.
- Name software tools only if the source names them. Never say one vendor is the best.
- AI voices: the AI disclosure lives in the written show notes{{ $json.spoken_ai_line ? ' and the one line in step 3' : '' }}. Never claim either speaker is recording live, in a studio, or in the room with the listener.
- Write numbers the way they are spoken ("thirty minutes", "five people").

## LENGTH ##
{{ $json.word_min }} to {{ $json.word_max }} words total (5 to 7 minutes). Pick the source's most useful points to fit.

## SOURCE ##
Topic: {{ $json.topic }}
{{ $json.compiled_content }}

Start with {{ $json.cohost_name }}'s hook line.

=You prepare the publishing details for one episode of "{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.show_name }}", the podcast from {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.brand_name }} (host Billy Jordan, founder; AI co-host {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.cohost_name }}) for {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.listener }}. Plain English, no hype, no promised results.

Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences, with exactly these keys:
- "title": the episode title, 60 to 95 characters, question-first or answer-first, plain and specific. Example: "Why Your CRM Isn't Following Up on Leads (and the 3 Fixes That Do)"
- "slug": lowercase words joined by hyphens, at most 80 characters, built from the title without filler words
- "question": the ONE owner question this episode answers, as one plain sentence
- "topic": exactly one of "Lead Follow-Up", "AI Receptionists", "CRM", "Workflow Automation", "AI Search", "Operations", "Case Study"
- "quick_answer": 150 to 200 characters: the direct answer, then "Billy Jordan of {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.brand_name }} explains."
- "summary": 1 to 2 sentences, at most 280 characters, for the podcast apps
- "seo_title": at most 60 characters, keyword first
- "meta_description": at most 155 characters
- "bullets": exactly 3 short "In this episode" bullet points, each under 110 characters
- "duplicate_of": if the QUESTION is essentially the same question as one already answered below, the number of that episode; otherwise null. Same topic is NOT a duplicate.

## EXISTING EPISODES (number, topic, question) ##
{{ $('Ledger Questions').first().json.ledger_questions }}

## SOURCE TITLE ##
{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.topic }}

## SCRIPT ##
{{ $('Script Gate').first().json.final_script }}
={{ ":recycle: *[Breakpoint] Skipped: this question is already answered by episode " + $json.duplicate_of + "*\n*Question:* " + $json.question + "\nNothing was spent on voices." }}

={{ ":email: [Breakpoint] New episode script emailed to " + $('Show Settings').first().json.approval_email + " for approval: *" + $json.title + "* (" + $json.topic + ", about " + $json.est_minutes + " min). Airs " + $json.release_label + " if approved." + ($json.show_ready ? "" : " (Not ready: no Transistor show yet, so approving won't make audio.)") }}

={{ "[Breakpoint] " + ($json.declined ? ":x: Declined" : ":hourglass: No answer in 12 hours (weekday), so it was skipped") + ": " + $('Read Episode Details').first().json.title + "\nNothing was spent on voices. Send it through the Breakpoint form again to retry." }}

={{ ":no_entry: *[Breakpoint] Script did not pass the checks, so no audio was made*
*Source:* " + ($('Build Script Input').first().json.source_url || 'topic brief') + "
*Problems:* " + $json.violations.join(", ") + "
Nothing was spent on voices." }}

A writer drafted the two-person script below from the source. FIND and FIX problems with the smallest possible edits. You are strict and you do not rewrite for style.

## CHECK EVERY LINE AGAINST THESE RULES ##
{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.editor_fact_rule }}

3. No promised results: remove "guaranteed", "risk-free", "will double", "overnight", "set it and forget it", and any specific saving, revenue or hours figure that is not in the source.
4. Remove invented client names, testimonials and case-study results. A general TYPE of business ("a five-person HVAC company") is fine.

6. The CTA line must be exactly: "{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.cta_line }}" Billy's outro must be exactly: "I'm Billy Jordan with {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.brand_name }}. Go build something that runs without you. Until next time."{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.spoken_ai_line ? ' Billy says this line exactly once, in his first line: "' + $('Build Script Input').first().json.spoken_ai_line + '"' : '' }}
7. Format: every line starts with "{{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.cohost_name }}:" or "Billy:". A speaker name with a colon appears ONLY at the very start of a line. The recap is ONE {{ $('Build Script Input').first().json.cohost_name }} line: "Three things to remember. One, ... Two, ... Three, ..." Keep the hook as line one, and keep the verbatim intro, CTA, outro and close lines exactly as written.
8. Length: do not cut anything to change the length. Length is Billy's call.

// Breakpoint podcast settings. Billy (or Claude) changes the values here; nothing else needs editing.
// Every Breakpoint workflow reads its settings from this one node. The insurance shows never read it.
const S = {
  show_name: 'Work ON Your Business',              // DRAFT name from brands/breakpoint.md. Billy to confirm.
  brand_name: 'Breakpoint Systems',                // How the company name is said and written.
  host_name: 'Billy Jordan',
  cohost_name: 'Tanya',                            // Speaker label in the script. Must match cohost_voice.
  host_voice: '2dIruLdSTKfsYrmyR4YG',              // Billy's cloned ElevenLabs voice.
  cohost_voice: 'Rv3wiuHHQq0rSS4QVaQ8',            // Tanya for now. Swap for a different stock voice if Billy wants the shows to sound different.
  listener: 'owners and founders of service businesses with 5 to 50 people',
  website: 'https://www.breakpointsystems.com',
  own_domains: 'breakpointsystems.com',            // Links on these sites count as our own, already-approved content.
  cta_line: 'If you want help putting this to work in your business, book an automation audit with Billy and his team at breakpointsystems.com.',
  cta_must_contain: 'breakpointsystems.com',       // The gate blocks a script whose call to action is missing this.
  spoken_ai_line: '',                              // Optional on-air line saying the voices are AI. Blank = disclosure lives in the show notes only.
  transistor_show_id: '',                          // REQUIRED before any audio is made. Billy creates the show in Transistor, then paste its ID here.
  apple_podcasts_url: '',
  release_days: 'Tue',                             // Days episodes air, e.g. 'Tue' (weekly) or 'Mon,Wed,Fri'.
  release_time: '09:00',                           // Eastern time.
  use_music: 'no',                                 // 'yes' uses intro/outro music files (none made for Breakpoint yet).
  music_intro_path: '',
  music_outro_path: '',
  approval_email: 'billy@agencyhlpc.com',
  slack_channel: 'C0C8A3WRQA1',                    // Same channel as the insurance podcast. Messages start with [Breakpoint].
  webflow_collection_id: '',                       // Breakpoint site has no Podcast collection yet. Blank = no website page is made.
  ledger_table_id: 'fII8YCB84TQBpd5X',             // n8n table "Breakpoint Podcast Ledger" (created Oct 16).
  episode_word_min: '850',
  episode_word_max: '1050'
};
return [{ json: { ...S, ...($input.first().json || {}) } }];
